question: How is the teaching on beautiful nondual conduct characterized in relation to knowledge?
premises: Beautiful nondual conduct is the subject
It is presented as the determination of knowledge
inference: The beautiful nondual conduct is declared as the definitive ascertainment of knowledge.
uncertainties: The grammatical agreement between kathitaṃ and jñānanirṇayam is slightly compressed in this fragment
plain_english: The beautiful nondual conduct has been declared as the determination of knowledge.
